headline: Cordelia Cruises reports Rs 58.5 crore profit
hook: Cordelia Cruises returns to profitability in Q2
summary: Waterways Leisure Tourism, the operator of Cordelia Cruises, reported a consolidated net profit of Rs 58.5 crore for Q2FY27, reversing a loss from the same period last year. Revenue grew 30% year-on-year to Rs 133 crore, supported by a shift to positive EBITDA. CEO Jurgen Bailom attributed the growth to the expanding cruise holiday sector. The company is now focused on managing its balance sheet and asset expansion.
why_it_matters: Cruise tourism sector shows signs of financial recovery.

headline: Waterways Leisure Tourism submits Q2 2026 demat compliance certificate
hook: Routine regulatory filing for Waterways Leisure
summary: Waterways Leisure Tourism has filed its demat compliance certificate with SEBI for the second quarter of 2026. This is a standard regulatory requirement for listed companies to ensure shareholding transparency. The filing confirms the company's adherence to depository participant norms for the period.

headline: Waterways Leisure Tourism adds second cruise ship Cordelia Sky to its fleet
hook: Second vessel added to cruise fleet
summary: Waterways Leisure Tourism has taken delivery of its second vessel, the 848-foot-long Cordelia Sky, which features 12 decks, 10 food and beverage venues, and 11 bars and lounges. The new cruise ship has a capacity of over 2,400 passengers. This expansion increases the company's operational capacity in the leisure tourism segment. Indian retail investors should note this fleet expansion as a measure of the company's business growth in the domestic cruise tourism market.
why_it_matters: Fleet expansion broadens the company's capacity in leisure tourism.

headline: Waterways Leisure Tourism reports Rs 81.27 crore profit for H1 FY27
hook: Profit triples for Waterways Leisure Tourism
summary: Waterways Leisure Tourism recorded a net profit of Rs 81.27 crore for the first half of the 2027 fiscal year. This figure represents a 215% increase compared to the previous period. The company operates within the leisure and tourism sector, which has seen varying demand trends. Retail investors should note the significant earnings growth as a potential indicator of operational efficiency or increased market demand.
why_it_matters: Strong earnings growth may signal potential stock price appreciation.

headline: Waterways Leisure Tourism reports robust Q2 and H1 FY27 financial performance
hook: Strong numbers from the leisure operator
summary: Waterways Leisure Tourism Limited released its financial results for Q2 and H1 FY27 on October 9, 2026. The company posted an EBITDA of Rs 776.82 million and a PAT of Rs 584.96 million. This indicates solid operational performance for the period. Retail investors should note the reported earnings growth as an indicator of sector demand.
why_it_matters: Earnings growth signals healthy demand in the leisure sector.
winners_losers: Waterways Leisure holders gain / none hurt

headline: Waterways Leisure Tourism submits investor presentation to the exchange
hook: Routine corporate update from Waterways Leisure
summary: Waterways Leisure Tourism Limited, operating under the brand Cordelia, has submitted its latest investor presentation to the stock exchange. The filing is a standard disclosure providing operational and financial updates to shareholders. Indian retail investors holding the stock can review the presentation on the exchange website for insights into the company's performance and strategy.
why_it_matters: Review presentation for company strategy and performance updates

headline: Waterways Leisure Tourism reports financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026
summary: Waterways Leisure Tourism Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. This filing provides the company's financial performance data for the second quarter of fiscal 2027. Investors can review the reported revenue, margins, and net profit or loss figures from the exchange filing. Retail investors holding the stock can assess the company's recent operational performance and earnings health.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data allows holders to review financial health
